Therapeutic Qi Gong (Ba Duan Jin)

Therapy qi-gong movement-therapy tcm self-care

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Eight Brocades (Ba Duan Jin) is a classical qi gong sequence for cultivating vital energy, improving organ function, and promoting longevity. Suitable for all ages and fitness levels.

Type: mind_body

Benefits

  • stress resilience
  • improved balance and coordination
  • enhanced lung capacity
  • digestive regulation
  • emotional stability

Contraindications

  • acute severe illness
  • recent surgery (consult physician)
  • severe dizziness or vertigo

Session Duration: 15-30 minutes daily

Frequency Recommendation: Daily practice recommended; minimum 3x/week for benefits

Cost Range: Free (self-practice) or $15-30 for guided classes
